name: app-usability-test-heatmaps-and-task-table
title: User-testing results with a task table in floating pills and red-green heatmaps on app screens
whatItIs: A pale grey slide '13 User testing Result' with a heading, description, a table of tasks with average time, success rate and completion each in a soft white pill, and below a row of translucent phone screens overlaid with glowing red-to-green heat blobs.
whatItMeans: Evidence-driven and calm; heat blobs make attention tangible.
techniques: Show metrics as floating white pills on hairlines.
Overlay red-green blobs as heatmaps on real screens.
Use plain grey with tiny numerals.
Present five screens in a row.

vocabulary.definition: A glowing spot showing where users tapped.
A white capsule holding a measure.
A list of tasks with results.
Data drawn over a UI screenshot.
